name: call
doc: the call's contract of the mask-preparation pass (`mask_prepare_kernel`, csrc/fsla/src/mask_prepare/mask_prepare.cu): every width from 2 to 256 and a density of 1 to 4 levels. A list is alternatives, each its own context; a range is one context.

width.declared_by: docs/internals/mask_prepare/mask_prepare.md#the-kernel: a mask's width is a power of two from 2 (a level narrower is refused, fsla/routing/types.py) up to MAX_BRANCH_WIDTH 256, and the grid is sized for the widest

levels.declared_by: docs/internals/common/plan/mask_prepare_layout.md: a level-side's slot is side * 4 + level, so a density carries at most plan::kCarveMaxLevels = 4 levels
